rules.Core812_activation: timed_frontend && directory_ready && certified_candidate && probe!=HIT && (probe==RESERVATION_FAIL || nativeLineMSHR>=128). Source78 saturation only candidate-selection evidence.
rules.RO_traffic: accepted_ro>0 marks traffic present; traffic count>=1M and merge_fraction>=0.5 may be described numerically but do not classify activation/profitability
rules.Tag_reserved: UNKNOWN unless actual matching certified timed-head probe/RESERVATION_FAIL observation exists; detach is distinct actual event not occupancy proxy
rules.descriptor: actual pressure iff typed descriptor_full_events_sum>0; peak/cap512 kept continuous; no artificial high-pressure threshold
rules.memory_sensitivity: only exact matched modeledDRAM850->1020 option perturbation with Source5,input,ordered population,mode,allotheroptions equal; no arbitrary binary cutoff; retain measured fraction
rules.merge: merges/accepted_RO requester admissions only, undefined when denominator0; not fraction of DRAM traffic removed
rules.ordinary_line_MSHR: Actual saturation iff measured line_full_events_sum>0; peak128 alone is occupancy not denied request. Exact native line capacity128. A zero means none observed in that exact mode/source/config, not universally safe.
